citationText: “How Dolby and TVP Are Bringing Next Generation Immersive Audio to Football Fans at Home,” [Online]. Available: https://dolbyac4.com/uk/dist/pdf/TVP_AC4_Case_study.phpDolby demonstrated a prototype linear broadcast chain producing content in the serial ADM format and then transmitting it as AC-4 to a consumer TV (Fig. 11). Several of the prototype tools developed by Dolby for this project have been made available open source to assist others in the industry to develop their own tools. Next Steps With AC-4 In several countries, the focus has been shifted from discussing theoretical possibilities of NGA to making ecosystems really come to life, so that consumers can enjoy the benefits. To ensure that AC-4 use cases are well identified and that manufacturers can build appropriate devices, Dolby is supporting the creation of example streams, test vectors, and other materials specific to regional markets. For example, DVB AC-4 test streams for NorDig use cases are now available in the official NorDig Test Plan. DVB AC-4 test streams for French broadcaster use cases were used in the recent FAVN UHDTV plugfest. One key area that is gathering momentum is IBB and HbbTV. HbbTV provides a means for deployment of enhanced services, such as those with NGA, via streaming delivery. This is increasingly attractive as an opportunity for service innovation in a rapid and cost-effective manner. AC-4 is supported in HbbTV version 2.0.2, and the official HbbTV Association Test Suite now includes 28 AC-4 test cases to assist manufacturers in implementing NGA capabilities.23 To continue the work on professional content interchange, a key step will be to validate interoperability of third-party tools to author NGA content for AC-4 emission. It will also be important to apply practical learnings to refine and finalize proposed interchange profiles.
